whatIs.label: Is This Page For You?
whatIs.title: Is Appointment Management Slowing Your Business Down?
whatIs.paragraph1: Can't keep up with ringing phones during the day? Are your customers returning empty-handed when they try to book outside of business hours? Are cancellations, last-minute changes, and double-bookings paralyzing your operations?
whatIs.paragraph2: Manual appointment management doesn't just steal your time; it paves the way for human error, damages the customer experience, and limits your capacity for growth. An automated system gives you and your team the freedom to focus on your actual work.
whatIs.paragraph3: As Sybor Digital, we develop 100% automated appointment and reservation systems that seamlessly adapt to your specific workflow—from clinics to beauty salons, consulting offices to sports facilities.

physical.description: I want to manage patient appointments with the flawlessness of a digital assistant, without manual errors, and fully compliant with data protection regulations.

startup.description: I want a system that will optimize my staff-based services and reduce customer no-show rates to zero with instant reminders.

growing.title: Consultants & Independent Experts

whatWeDo.label: How We Help You
whatWeDo.title: Flawless Reservation Infrastructure Working 24/7
whatWeDo.paragraph1: Continue accepting reservations even when your business doors are closed. Minimize cancellations and no-shows by sending automatic SMS and email reminders to your customers prior to their appointments.
whatWeDo.paragraph2: We pinpoint and integrate your staff's working hours, days off, break times, and the duration of their services into the system, completely eliminating scheduling conflicts and operational errors.
whatWeDo.paragraph3: With the virtual POS infrastructure we integrate into the system, you can collect deposits or full payments at the time of booking, securing your revenue and automatically enforcing your cancellation policies.
whatWeDo.cardDescription: All the tools you need to put your operations on autopilot, under one roof.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Things you might be wondering about appointment and reservation automations.

delivery.question: How long does it take to set up and launch the system?
delivery.answer: Basic appointment and calendar systems are usually deployed within 2-3 weeks. More comprehensive systems with custom CRM and payment integrations can take 4-6 weeks.

pricing.question: How does your pricing model work?
pricing.answer: We work with an operations-friendly one-time setup fee and a monthly/annual license model, determined by your staff count, service capacity, and integration needs.

revisions.question: Can I change staff hours, leaves, and service prices myself?
revisions.answer: Absolutely. Through the extremely simple admin panel we will provide, you can instantly update all shift plannings, price changes, and service durations.

maintenance.question: Do I need to have a website built from scratch, or can you add it to my current site?
maintenance.answer: You don't need to have a site built from scratch. We can seamlessly integrate the booking engine (widget) we develop directly into your existing website.

migration.question: Can we import my existing past and future appointments into the new system?
migration.answer: Yes, to ensure you experience zero data loss, we securely import your existing appointment and customer data from Excel or your old software into your new system.

mobile.question: Do customers have to download a mobile app to book an appointment?
mobile.answer: No, our booking system is 100% web-based and flawlessly compatible with all mobile devices. However, if you want a custom native mobile app for your business, we can develop that separately.
